sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB (Oct 23)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: 8B total / 4B effective MoE from Gemma 4 E4B plus Nemotron post-training; 64K context (corrected from r1 1M misattribution); 35 languages building on 140+ base; conversational plus multi-turn agentic use.
claims.context: NVIDIA Nemotron research page (Published Oct 23 + technical report)

claims.text: Quality: ~40% higher average than prior Nano 4B, ~10% above peers; up to 80% fewer output tokens in reasoning-enabled comparisons; Tau2-Bench 55.1 vs Gemma 38.5; RULER 64K 87.0; Brevity 82.5; AgentIF 25.8; GaRAGe 42.6; RelyTool 63.2.
claims.context: NVIDIA Nemotron research page benchmark tables (BF16, per-benchmark reasoning mode)

claims.text: Training: RLVR plus RLHF via NeMo-RL/Gym, 2:1 non-reasoning sampling; DFlash parallel drafter up to 21% higher throughput vs Gemma MTP; checkpoints GGUF/DFlash/BF16/NVFP4; deploy via HF/Ollama/LM Studio/Unsloth/Canonical/Jetson AI/In-Game SDK.
Open weights, data and recipes; OpenMDW-1.1 license (OSI approval NOT established); Jetson Orin Nano 8GB local demo with Cosmos 3 Edge vision.
claims.context: NVIDIA Nemotron research page (availability + Reachy Mini demo)

limitations.text: All benchmarks vendor-reported with vendor-chosen reasoning modes; OpenMDW-1.1 OSI status unproven; HF license file and technical report PDF unopened; no independent run
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
